problem_text: The sequence a_1, a_2, ... of integers satisfies the conditions: (1) 1 ≤ a_j ≤ 2015 for all j ≥ 1, (2) k + a_k ≠ l + a_l for all 1 ≤ k < l. Prove that there exist two positive integers b and N for which |∑_{j=m+1}^{n} (a_j - b)| ≤ 1007^2 for all integers m, n such that N ≤ m < n.
solution_text: We follow the juggling solution. Consider a collection of balls at different integer heights that starts out empty at time 0 and is modified at each succeeding integer time t as follows: If there is a ball at height 0 it is removed (caught); Then a ball is added at height a_t; Then all balls have their height decreased by 1. Condition 1 ensures that all heights stay in [0, 2014]. Condition 2 ensures that the heights at any point in time are distinct, so we can model the collection as a finset of heights of monotonically increasing, bounded cardinality. So there is a time where the cardinality reaches a maximum; we take N to be that time and b to be that maximum cardinality. 1 ≤ b ≤ 2015. Let S_t be the sum of heights at time t. The key observation is that for all t ≥ N, S_{t+1} = S_t + a_{t+1} - b because 0 must be in the set of heights at time t (otherwise the cardinality will increase); this height is replaced by a_{t+1} and then all b balls have their height decreased by 1. Thus |∑_{j=m+1}^{n} (a_j - b)| = |S_n - S_m|. Now for all t ≥ N, ∑_{i=0}^{b-1} i ≤ S_t ≤ 0 + ∑_{i=0}^{b-2} (2014-i), so the absolute difference is upper-bounded by ∑_{i=0}^{b-2} (2014-i) - (b-1) - ∑_{i=0}^{b-2} (b-2-i) = (b-1)(2015-b) ≤ 1007^2.
solution_summary: 将序列翻译为抛接球(juggling)物理模型：a_j是抛球高度，j+a_j是落地时间，条件2保证没有两球同时落地。球数(pool基数)单调递增且有界，稳定后取b=最大球数、N=稳定时刻。稳定后必有高度0的球，高度和S_t满足S_{t+1}=S_t+a_{t+1}-b，望远镜求和将部分和归结为|S_n-S_m|，用极值bound得到(b-1)(2015-b)≤1007²。
answer: 存在正整数b和N，使得对所有满足N≤m<n的整数m,n，|∑_{j=m+1}^{n}(a_j-b)| ≤ 1007²。其中b是抛接球模型中pool的最大基数，N是pool基数稳定的时刻。
structure_features: 整数序列满足值域约束(1≤a_j≤2015)+单射约束(k+a_k互不相同)，需证存在性命题(存在b,N使部分和有界)。核心结构是条件2的单射性可翻译为物理模型——j+a_j作为落地时间互不相同恰好是合法抛接球模式的定义。
key_insight: 将序列条件翻译为抛接球(juggling)物理模型——a_j是抛球高度，j+a_j是落地时间，injectivity意味着没有两球同时落地，从而pool基数单调有界稳定后给出b和N
expected_ai_method: bare AI会尝试直接分析部分和，利用单射性推导密度约束，或做case analysis，但不会发现抛接球物理模型翻译
correct_method: 抛接球物理模型——将序列翻译为球的抛接过程，利用pool基数单调有界稳定得到b和N，通过高度和望远镜求和将部分和归结为|S_n-S_m|的界

rounds.question: 关键思维操作：将序列翻译为物理模型。a_j是时刻j抛球高度，j+a_j是什么？条件2物理含义？
rounds.expected_answer: j+a_j是球落地时刻。条件2=没有两球同时落地=合法抛接球(juggling)模式。

rounds.question: 发展抛接球模型。时刻t空中有多少球？随时间如何变化？能无限增长吗？
rounds.expected_answer: pool(t)是空中球高度集合。每步移除0号球、加入a_t、全部减1。球数单调不减（有0号球不变，没有则加1），被2015 bound→稳定在最大值b，稳定时刻N。

rounds.question: 利用稳定状态。t≥N后pool恒有b个球意味着什么？设S_t为高度之和，计算S_{t+1}-S_t。
rounds.expected_answer: 必有高度0的球（否则球数增加）。S_{t+1}=(S_t-0+a_{t+1})-b=S_t+a_{t+1}-b。望远镜求和：∑(a_j-b)=S_n-S_m。

rounds.question: 最后bound |S_n-S_m|。b个不同高度在[0,2014]内且含0，S_t的min和max？上界？

analysis_metadata.notes: IMO 2015 P6 - juggling model solution (Evan Chen solution 2). Key insight is physical model translation from sequence conditions to ball juggling process. The problem is a classic example of method_translation gap: bare AI cannot discover the juggling interpretation from local analysis.
